items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee (Roy Eldridge) mentions Benny Goodman only in the context of Fletcher Henderson's career ('he did all that stuff with Benny in '35') and as a comparison for recording arrangements. There is no evidence of a direct professional or personal relationship between Roy Eldridge and Benny G

ctx.x: Yeah! And there was a difference, you know? Then the biggest goof of all, when he said, "Well, do you think you might go back with Gene or Benny Goodman or Artie Shaw?" and I said, "Now I have my own group." What's wrong
